Reliable Power, Enhanced Features.

Tough Compact Tractor with Bonus Value and Proven Performance.

The 2024 KIOTI CK3520SEMB is a special edition version of the reliable CK3520, offering the same rugged design with upgraded standard features. With 35 HP and a mechanical shuttle transmission, this compact workhorse is ready for loader work, mowing, tilling, and more. The “SE” package adds convenience and comfort without sacrificing durability—making it a favorite for serious property owners and land managers.

Features may include:

35 HP KIOTI Diesel Engine
Powerful and fuel-efficient 3-cylinder engine designed for dependable performance in all conditions.

8F/8R Mechanical Shuttle Transmission
Eases shifting during loader work and tight space maneuvering with smooth directional control.

3-Point Hitch with Strong Lift Capacity
Category I hitch with 1,631 lbs of lift capacity handles a variety of rear implements.

Deluxe SE Upgrades
Includes rear work light, telescopic lower link ends, toolbox, and dual remotes for enhanced versatility.

Independent PTO
540 RPM PTO is electronically engaged, making it easy to run mowers, tillers, and other implements.

ROPS Operator Station
Open platform with suspension seat, ergonomic controls, and foldable ROPS for safety and visibility.

Power Steering & 4WD Standard
Designed for confident operation in tight spaces or across rough terrain.
